Before-and-after performance claims with specific timelines ('results within a couple days')

Compensation pattern framing (e.g., 'Even the healthiest horses develop compensation patterns')
Diagnostic symptom lists (resistance, stiffness, behavioral changes, decreased performance)
Preventative angle (e.g., 'Regular bodywork identifies imbalances before they become problems')

Mobile barn-call setup (horse in stall or pasture, handler present)
Practitioner portrait in outdoor/ranch setting (trust/lifestyle framing)
Posture correction carousel (static posture photos, alignment diagrams)
raw_summary: Competitors emphasize clinical diagnostics, rapid visible improvement (24–72 hours), and rodeo/performance credibility. Common messaging pairs problem identification (lameness, behavioral changes, compensation patterns) with specific anatomical fixes (TMJ, poll, hocks, thoracolumbar). VOM (veterinary orthopedic manipulation) gains traction in rodeo circles as an alternative to manual adjustment. Bodywork (Masterson Method, myofascial release) is increasingly framed as a separate-but-complementary layer to chiropractic. Texas and Montana markets show strong mobile/barn-call adoption with emphasis on working with ranch horses, show livestock, and rodeo athletes. Educational content (FAQ carousels, technique breakdowns, stretching tutorials) dominates Instagram/Facebook strategy. Before-and-after gait video appears to be the highest-engagement visual format.
